text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from examples and data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced type of machine learning, uses large neural networks to process complex information, like identifying faces or translating speech. AI is already part of everyday life. It powers virtual assistants, recommends movies or products online, helps with navigation, filters spam emails, and even assists doctors in diagnosing diseases, making our lives more convenient and efficient.
